verdict.rationale: Pomelo's API reference shows URL-versioned endpoint paths (/cards/v1, users v2, core-credit-v2) and labels one endpoint group "Push Provisioning (Deprecado)", so APIs are versioned and deprecations are flagged. However, no versioning policy, deprecation window or changelog is published, so the documented-policy half of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a published versioning/deprecation policy with notice windows, a changelog, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: URL-versioned endpoint paths (/cards/v1, users v2, core-credit-v2) and a deprecated endpoint group labeled "Push Provisioning (Deprecado)"
